title_en: USPS Files January 2027 Prices: 5.9% Increase Plus an 11% Fuel Surcharge
title_zh: USPS 公布 2027 年 1 月运价：平均上涨 5.9%，另加 11% 燃油附加费
desc_en: USPS filed January 17, 2027 prices: domestic shipping up 5.9% on average plus an 11% fuel surcharge, international up 7.9%. Sample rates and seller actions.
desc_zh: USPS 11 月 12 日提交 2027 年调价：1 月 17 日起国内运价平均上涨 5.9%，另加 11% 燃油附加费，国际运价上涨 7.9%。本文附上 Ground Advantage 不同重量与分区的运价示例，以及卖家在新价生效前应完成的调整清单。
body_en:
USPS has put numbers on its 2027 package prices. On November 12, 2026, the Postal Service filed notice with the Postal Regulatory Commission (PRC) for price changes taking effect January 17, 2027: an average 5.9% increase on domestic shipping plus a fuel surcharge of 11%. This is a follow-up to our October 28 article on the planned USPS fuel surcharge, with the new details sellers were waiting for.

What USPS filed

According to the USPS announcement (Nov 12, 2026), approved by the USPS Board of Governors that week:

  • Domestic prices +5.9% on average for Priority Mail, Priority Mail Express, USPS Ground Advantage and Parcel Select, effective January 17, 2027.
  • 11% fuel surcharge. The 8% "transportation-related" increase implemented in April 2026 becomes a permanent 8% fuel surcharge, "plus an additional 3 percent given the recent further elevation of fuel prices for a total of 11 percent."
  • Review in July 2027. The surcharge "will not impact international products at this time" and will be reevaluated in July 2027 based on fuel prices in the first half of 2027.
  • International prices +7.9% on average for Priority Mail Express International, Priority Mail International, First-Class Package International Service and International Priority Airmail.
  • Competitive PO Box prices are not changing in January. The PRC will review the changes before they take effect (Docket No. CP2027-1).

Spectrum News (Nov 13) reported the same figures. According to Supply Chain Dive (Nov 13), the 5.9% average "matches the averages of FedEx and UPS' upcoming rate hikes." It also reports, citing the PRC filing, that the surcharge will be fixed in January but USPS "eventually intends to adjust the rate on a weekly basis" using EIA fuel prices, with the dynamic surcharge to be authorized "later in 2027."

Sample January 2027 Ground Advantage prices

USPS has already posted the proposed price files on Postal Explorer. These are commercial Ground Advantage base prices from the January 2027 file (dated Nov 12, 2026), with our calculation of the price after the 11% surcharge (Calculation: base × 1.11, rounded; USPS's own rounding may differ slightly):

WeightZone 1Zone 5Zone 8
4 oz, base$6.90$7.61$8.27
4 oz, with 11% surcharge≈ $7.66≈ $8.45≈ $9.18
1 lb, base$7.97$8.77$10.18
1 lb, with 11% surcharge≈ $8.85≈ $9.73≈ $11.30
5 lb, base$9.61$13.23$18.30
5 lb, with 11% surcharge≈ $10.67≈ $14.69≈ $20.31

The proposed fuel surcharge tables in the same file list 11% for both the diesel-based and jet-fuel-based surcharges.

The financial background

Supply Chain Dive reports that USPS posted a $6.5 billion net loss in fiscal 2026, while shipping and packages revenue rose 5.1% year over year despite a 5.3% volume decline. In other words, USPS is earning more per package, and the 2027 changes continue that strategy.

What it means for sellers (our analysis)

  • Compare totals, not base rates. The January base prices look close to today's because the 8% temporary increase moves out of the base and into the surcharge. Your actual cost is base plus 11%.
  • USPS is no longer the "no fuel surcharge" carrier. With UPS and FedEx also raising rates about 5.9% on average, the gap between carriers now depends more on surcharges, zones and your negotiated discounts.
  • Budget for change in mid-2027. The 11% is reviewed in July and a weekly surcharge is planned later, so treat 11% as a starting point.
  • Cross-border shippers using USPS international services face a 7.9% average increase, but no fuel surcharge for now.

Checklist before January 17

  1. Re-rate your top 20 SKUs by weight and zone using the January price file plus 11%.
  2. Update shipping templates on Amazon, Walmart, TikTok Shop and your own site so customer-paid shipping still covers cost.
  3. Check package dimensions and weight; see our Ground Advantage guide for pricing rules.
  4. Ask your label provider when the new rates and surcharge will appear in your software.
  5. Compare USPS against regional carriers for zones 5–8, where the dollar increase is largest.

body_zh:
USPS 2027 年的包裹运价定下来了。2026 年 11 月 12 日，美国邮政向邮政监管委员会（PRC）提交调价通知，2027 年 1 月 17 日起生效：国内运输平均上涨 5.9%，另加 11% 的燃油附加费。本文是 10 月 28 日关于 USPS 燃油附加费的文章 的后续，补上了卖家一直在等的具体数字。

USPS 提交了什么

根据 USPS 官方新闻稿（2026 年 11 月 12 日），经理事会当周批准：

  • 国内运价平均上涨 5.9%：适用于 Priority Mail、Priority Mail Express、USPS Ground Advantage 和 Parcel Select，2027 年 1 月 17 日生效。
  • 11% 燃油附加费：2026 年 4 月实施的 8%"运输相关"临时涨价，将转为永久性 8% 燃油附加费，再因近期燃油价格进一步上涨加收 3 个百分点，合计 11%。
  • 2027 年 7 月复核：附加费"暂不适用于国际产品"，将根据 2027 年上半年燃油价格在 7 月重新评估。
  • 国际运价平均上涨 7.9%：包括 Priority Mail Express International、Priority Mail International、First-Class Package International Service 和 International Priority Airmail。
  • 竞争性邮政信箱（PO Box）价格 1 月不变。调价生效前需经 PRC 审查（案卷号 CP2027-1）。

Spectrum News（11 月 13 日） 报道了相同的数字。据 Supply Chain Dive（11 月 13 日） 报道，5.9% 的平均涨幅与 FedEx、UPS 即将实施的平均涨幅一致；该报道还引述 PRC 文件称，1 月的附加费是固定比例，但 USPS"最终打算按周调整"，依据美国能源信息署（EIA）的燃油价格，动态附加费将在"2027 年晚些时候"获批。

2027 年 1 月 Ground Advantage 运价示例

USPS 已在 Postal Explorer 发布拟议价格文件。下表为 2027 年 1 月文件（2026 年 11 月 12 日版）中的 Ground Advantage 商业基础运价，以及我们计算的加收 11% 附加费后的价格（计算方法：基础运价 × 1.11，四舍五入；USPS 实际取整可能略有不同）：

重量1 区5 区8 区
4 盎司，基础运价6.90 美元7.61 美元8.27 美元
4 盎司，含 11% 附加费约 7.66 美元约 8.45 美元约 9.18 美元
1 磅，基础运价7.97 美元8.77 美元10.18 美元
1 磅，含 11% 附加费约 8.85 美元约 9.73 美元约 11.30 美元
5 磅，基础运价9.61 美元13.23 美元18.30 美元
5 磅，含 11% 附加费约 10.67 美元约 14.69 美元约 20.31 美元

同一文件中的燃油附加费表，柴油和航空煤油两类附加费均为 11%。

财务背景

据 Supply Chain Dive 报道，USPS 2026 财年净亏损 65 亿美元；运输与包裹业务收入同比增长 5.1%，但件量下降 5.3%。也就是说，USPS 单件收入在提高，2027 年调价延续了这一策略。

我们的解读

  • 比总价，不要只比基础运价。1 月的基础运价看起来和现在差不多，是因为 8% 临时涨价从基础价中移出、改为附加费。实际成本是基础运价再加 11%。
  • USPS 不再是"没有燃油附加费"的承运商。UPS 和 FedEx 也平均上涨约 5.9%，各家之间的差距更多取决于附加费、分区和你拿到的协议折扣。
  • 2027 年中还会变。11% 将在 7 月复核，之后还计划改为按周调整，预算时把 11% 当作起点。
  • 跨境发货使用 USPS 国际服务的，平均上涨 7.9%，但目前不加燃油附加费。

1 月 17 日前的行动清单

  1. 用 1 月价格文件加 11%，按重量和分区重新测算销量前 20 的 SKU 运费。
  2. 更新 Amazon、Walmart、TikTok Shop 和独立站的运费模板，确保买家支付的运费仍能覆盖成本。
  3. 核对包裹尺寸和重量，计价规则见我们的 Ground Advantage 指南。
  4. 向你的面单服务商确认新运价和附加费何时在系统中生效。
  5. 5–8 区涨幅金额最大，可与区域快递对比价格。
